note: depth pass 5: L4 例词补充

words.glossEn: balanced correspondence of parts on opposite sides
words.etymology: 希腊 symmetria < syn-（共同）+ metron（尺度）
derivation: sym（共同）+ metr（尺度）+ -y → 尺度相合
words.example: The building's symmetry is best seen from the river.

words.glossEn: relating to measurement; based on the metre
words.etymology: 希腊 metron「尺度」+ -ic
derivation: metr（度量）+ -ic → 关于度量的
words.example: The lab reports every figure in metric units.

words.glossEn: one thousandth of a gram
words.etymology: 拉丁 mille「千」+ 法语 gramme「克」
derivation: milli（千分之一）+ gram（克）→ 千分之一克
words.example: The tablet contains five milligrams of the drug.

words.glossEn: one thousandth of a metre
words.etymology: 拉丁 mille「千」+ metron「尺度」
derivation: milli（千分之一）+ metr（米）+ -er → 千分之一米
words.example: The crack widened by a millimeter each year.

words.glossEn: changed in form, especially rock altered by heat
words.etymology: 希腊 meta-（转变）+ morphē「形状」+ -ic
derivation: meta（转变）+ morph（形状）+ -ic → 形状改变的
words.example: Marble is a metamorphic rock derived from limestone.

words.glossEn: the study of form and structure
words.etymology: 希腊 morphē「形状」+ -logia「学问」
derivation: morph（形状）+ o + logy（学科）→ 研究形态的学问
words.example: The course covers the morphology of flowering plants.

words.glossEn: involving three or more parties or countries
words.etymology: 拉丁 multus「多」+ latus/lateris「边」+ -al
derivation: mult（多）+ i + later（边）+ -al → 多边的
words.example: The two sides signed a multilateral trade agreement.

words.glossEn: consisting of more than one part or instance
words.etymology: 拉丁 multiplex < multus「多」+ plicare（折叠）
derivation: mult（多）+ i + ple（折）→ 折成多层 → 多个的
words.example: The report lists multiple causes for the failure.

words.glossEn: to share information or feelings with others
words.etymology: 拉丁 communicare「共享、使公共」< communis「共同的」
derivation: com（共同）+ mun（公共服务）+ -ic- + -ate → 使成为共同所有
words.example: The two teams communicate mainly by email.

words.glossEn: a group sharing a place, interest, or identity
words.etymology: 拉丁 communitas < communis「共同的」
derivation: com（共同）+ mun（公共负担）+ -ity → 共担义务的一群人
words.example: The library is run by the local community.

words.glossEn: to plan and direct a course, especially at sea
words.etymology: 拉丁 navigare < navis「船」+ agere（驱动）
derivation: nav（船）+ -ig-（驱动）+ -ate → 驾船前行
words.example: They navigated the channel without a pilot.

words.glossEn: a country's military force at sea
words.etymology: 古法语 navie「船队」< 拉丁 navis「船」
derivation: nav（船）+ -y（集合）→ 船队 → 海军
words.example: He served in the navy for six years.

words.glossEn: to destroy something completely
words.etymology: 晚期拉丁 annihilare < ad-（向）+ nihil（无）
derivation: an（使…）+ nihil（无）+ -ate → 使化为无
words.example: The flood annihilated the lower village.

words.glossEn: the belief that nothing has real value or meaning
words.etymology: 拉丁 nihil「无」+ -ism
derivation: nihil（无）+ -ism（主义）→ 一切皆无的主张
words.example: The novel's ending drifts toward nihilism.

words.glossEn: to make legally void or ineffective
words.etymology: 晚期拉丁 nullificare < nullus「无」+ facere（做）
derivation: null（无）+ -ify（使…）→ 使归于无
words.example: The court nullified the contract.

words.glossEn: the state of being legally void; nothingness
words.etymology: 中世纪拉丁 nullitas < nullus「无」
derivation: null（无）+ -ity（性质）→ 无效的状态
words.example: The lawyer argued for the nullity of the marriage.

words.glossEn: using both eyes; (n.) an optical instrument for both eyes
words.etymology: 拉丁 bini「两个一组」+ oculus「眼」
derivation: bin（两个一组）+ ocul（眼）+ -ar → 双眼的
words.example: Depth perception depends on binocular vision.

words.glossEn: relating to the eye or to sight
words.etymology: 拉丁 ocularis < oculus「眼」
derivation: ocul（眼）+ -ar → 眼的
words.example: The infection causes ocular pain and redness.

words.glossEn: a dentist who straightens teeth
words.etymology: 希腊 orthos「直的」+ odous/odontos「牙」+ -ist
derivation: orth（正、直）+ odont（牙）+ -ist → 把牙弄直的人
words.example: The orthodontist fitted her with braces.

words.glossEn: relating to the tissue around the teeth
words.etymology: 希腊 peri-（周围）+ odous/odontos「牙」+ -al
derivation: peri（周围）+ odont（牙）+ -al → 牙周围的
words.example: Gum disease is a common periodontal problem.
